recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white photographic collage featuring fragmented close-up portraits of several men, arranged in a non-linear grid with sharp rectangular crops. A central typographic element is housed within a textured, olive-toned rectangular box.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking rectangular frames creating a puzzle-like composition
Contrast between stark white negative space and deep black shadows
Juxtaposition of large-scale facial features (eyes, hands) across different frames
Organic photographic textures versus geometric layout lines
coreInvariants: A single colored graphic element containing the primary text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Portraits are scaled inconsistently; one large face dominates the left, while smaller crops of eyes and partial faces fill the right and bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The olive-green rectangular text box located in the upper-right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves clockwise from the large portrait on the left, across the top eyes, to the text box, and down through the smaller facial fragments.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White rectangular blocks act as structural dividers between the photographic fragments.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and white photographic tones provide the structural base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white serves as the negative space and divider.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted olive-green/khaki for the central text block.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in photos; low saturation in the single accent color.

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke widths with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' features a deep V-shape reaching the baseline
Letters are tightly kerned to the point of touching

composition.relationshipToImage: Contained within a textured box overlaying the photos

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A small, wide-tracked sans-serif or slab-serif for secondary metadata placed directly below the main display text.
graphicDevices: Distressed marble or stone texture within the text box

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the sharp contrast and triangular serifs

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a collage of 5-6 high-contrast black and white male portraits. Use sharp rectangular crops. Arrange them so they are separated by thick white gutters. One large face on the left, eyes at the top and bottom. Ensure deep blacks and bright whites.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a horizontal olive-green rectangle in the upper right. Apply a white 'distressed stone' texture inside the rectangle. Add two lines of black text: the top line in a sharp, high-waisted decorative serif with interlocking letters; the bottom line in a small, wide-spaced sans-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the text box olive-toned with a distressed texture?
Do the display letters have sharp, triangular serifs?
Is the overall color palette strictly monochrome plus one accent color?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent text box

avoid: Soft edges or gradients between photos

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Verify the 'interlocking' nature of the display type
Ensure the texture in the text box looks like stone or grit
Confirm the layout uses a rigid, non-overlapping grid for the photos
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast B&W Portraits] in a [Geometric Grid Collage] with [White Gutters], anchored by a [Textured Color Block] containing [Sharp, High-Waisted Serif Typography].
